messages:
elaine: Quick thread 
We need a single-page prioritization for long-term routing policy work (multi-region + multi-tenant isolation) to share with execs tomorrow. Focus: highest-impact initiatives + easy wins. Can someone sketch a priority matrix? @cory

cory: I'll sketch. Top categories: operational resilience, customer isolation primitives, cost controls, policy-as-code + auditing. Rank by customer impact vs implementation effort.

ben: +1. Customer asks we should call out: (1) per-tenant region pinning, (2) soft-spill thresholds, (3) SLA tiers that can opt into dedicated lanes. Also need migration story for existing tenants.

priya: Compliance note: region pinning must be tied to contract flags & KMS validation. Also add an approval gate for any cross-region fallback for regulated accounts.

elaine: Cool. Can you put a very small decision table here that I can paste into the exec deck? Keep it 6 rows max.

cory: Draft below. Short labels only.

cory: ```yaml
priority_matrix:
  - initiative: "Tenant pinning"
    impact: "high"
    effort: "medium"
    notes: "contract + KMS gating"
  - initiative: "Soft spill thresholds"
    impact: "medium"
    effort: "low"
    notes: "ops config + metrics"
  - initiative: "Dedicated lane productization"
    impact: "high"
    effort: "high"
    notes: "billing + capacity contracts"
  - initiative: "Policy-as-code + telemetry"
    impact: "high"
    effort: "medium"
    notes: "audit + rollout scripts"
  - initiative: "KV-cache evacuation primitives"
    impact: "medium"
    effort: "low"
    notes: "runtime + runbook"
  - initiative: "Cross-region fallback QA harness"
    impact: "medium"
    effort: "medium"
    notes: "synthetic traffic + failure injections"
```

ben: Nice. Ops addendum: for "soft spill thresholds" we should define defaults (5%) and a clear opt-in path. For "KV-cache evacuation" target <30s for 95th percentile.

priya: Also recommend a short risk statement for each high-impact item in the slide: legal/residency, cost exposure, and latency variability.

elaine: Great. Two follow-ups: (1) @cory add owners + rough ETA (Q2/Q3), (2) product to prioritize a short RFC for tenant pinning + policy-as-code.

policy-bot: New RFC created: git.redwood/policy/routing-priority-matrix.md (PR 12)

cory: I'll open the RFC with owners: tenant-pinning -> ben; policy-as-code -> cory; dedicated lanes -> eng-leads. ETA estimates: tenant pinning Q2, policy-as-code Q2, dedicated lanes Q4.

elaine: Perfect. I'll fold this YAML and the 3-line risk bullets into the exec slide and share. If anyone has edits, reply here before COB. :rocket:
